# words were moved out of the core registry; they are reached only after
# §1  merge — deep, index-wise merge (later argument wins)
aql:struct import end Struct.merge {a:1 b:2} {b:3 c:4}
aql:struct import end Struct.merge {a:{x:1 y:2}} {a:{y:3 z:4}}

# §4  clone — deep copy (forward or stack form)
# §5  items — map entries as [key value] pairs
# §6  validate — check data against a shape spec (returns the validated spec)
